description: MARKARTH GLOBAL SURPLUS: Markarth is a mining city. All ores, ingots, and Dwarven/Silver weaponry are cheap.
MARKARTH GLOBAL DEFICIT: Provisions (Food/Wood) are expensive due to the rocky terrain.
SILVER-BLOOD MONOPOLY: The mines use slave labor. Silver and Gold are dirt cheap, and selling them locally yields almost nothing.
DWEMER SCRAP FLOOD: Markarth is built on a Dwemer city. Scrap is everywhere. Merchants are flooded with it.
REACH FAUNA FLORA: Juniper berries and moss grow naturally on the crags and are considered weeds by locals, goats and saber cats.
IMPORTED PROVISIONS: Farming on stone is impossible. Food is hauled up steep cliffs from the lowlands.
TIMBER DEFICIT: There are very few trees in the Reach. Fuel for the smelters is critical.
FORSWORN TRASH: Merchants consider 'savage' gear illegal or trash and will barely pay for it.
CIVILIZED GOODS: Markarth is rough and industrial. Scholars and fine tailors are rare.
